original_test_intent: Verify ECRC transmit and receive handling for every required OCP slot, including the specified immediate reset, durable direction-specific evidence, clean reboot and restoration of the OCP interface and dependent services after each injection.
original_method: Resolve correctable Criteria versus reset policy and prove errortype 2/3 direction semantics; map each OCP module/interface/service through NBIO/core/port; secure independent OOB management; decode AER/DPC/SyncFlood policy; quiesce traffic; execute TX and RX as separate approved reset cycles; correlate durable ECRC source/direction, boot and recovery; confirm link/interface/service health; restore all state.
manual_activity: The FAE maps and isolates the OCP path, resolves direction/severity/reset policy, performs TX and RX as separate OOB-controlled cycles and restores platform, interface and service health after each.
required_inputs: Vendor proof for pcieerror errortype 2/3 TX/RX semantics and severity
Decision reconciling correctable Criteria with mandatory immediate reset
OCP slot/module/FW/driver/interface/service to BDF/NBIO/core/port map and distinct coverage versus row 63
Independent OOB path plus management/storage/fabric dependency and traffic-isolation plan
Decoded 7EF6030, masks, DPC/SyncFlood/reset policy and durable AER/BMC/UEFI oracle
Supported OS, per-cycle reset/boot/service deadlines, aborts and restoration

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A live broad grep cannot persist across reset, attribute direction or prove OCP interface/service recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After OCP mapping and policy approval, run TX and RX as separate OOB-captured reset cycles and correlate durable source/direction evidence with complete interface/service recovery.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Tuple 0:0:1/core3/port0, errortype 2/3, two resets, correctable Criteria, OCP slot 1~N and 30/60-minute values remain preserved as unresolved source facts.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute separate topology-mapped OCP TX/RX ECRC reset cycles with durable OOB attribution and prove full interface/service recovery after each.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds distinct module/service identity, policy reconciliation, independent management, durable evidence, per-cycle closure and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Copied PCIe commands and post-boot dmesg cannot establish independent OCP coverage or preserved service.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A reset or failed recovery can remove management, storage or fabric connectivity and leave the OCP module or host unavailable.

project_override_considerations: If the OCP interface is the only management path, retain execution as pending until independent OOB access exists. Do not count row 64 separately from row 63 without physical identity and service evidence.
expected_evidence: Exact OCP module/interface/service and NBIO/core/port identity
Approved errortype direction and severity/reset matrix with decoded policy
TX durable ECRC source/direction plus reset/boot timeline and complete recovery
RX durable evidence and second complete recovery

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Correctable Criteria conflict with mandatory reset after each direction. Errortype 2/3 semantics are uncited; the fixed tuple duplicates PCIe row 63 and lacks OCP module/service identity; durable evidence and recovery deadlines are absent; severity value is undecoded, timeout undefined and RHEL 2022 ambiguous.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The OCP ECRC two-reset intent is statically reviewable. Execution remains gated on identity, authoritative semantics and independent recovery.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 64 Wistron-System RAS-00784-V002: prove pcieerror errortype 2/3 TX/RX semantics and reconcile correctable Criteria with immediate reset; provide OCP module/interface/service-to-NBIO/core/port mapping and distinct coverage versus PCIe row 63; approve 7EF6030/masks/DPC/SyncFlood, durable source/severity evidence, separate reset/boot/service deadlines, supported OS, aborts, independent OOB recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Makes the OCP case independently traceable and converts each direction into a durable, separately recovered reset cycle instead of accepting copied commands and volatile logs.
independent_technical_reasoning: An OCP error can sever management or fabric access exactly when the host resets, so the evidence and recovery channel must not depend on that interface. Identical commands to the PCIe companion do not prove separate hardware coverage. TX and RX results are valid only if durable source evidence survives each reset and the module, driver, link and services return to a documented baseline before the next cycle.
